verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a comprehensive public REST API (OAuth2 tokens, orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, disputes, webhooks) with OpenAPI specs, code generation, and a sandbox for testing, plus independent probes confirming live docs and endpoints. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer report of a full end-to-end integration confirming real-world reliability beyond PayPal's own docs and probes.
